title: Hollow Men Gather
sideASummary: Infection deck back. Red biohazard on a dark field. No printed text.
sideBSummary: HOLLOW MEN GATHER, code P2-21b. Same rules face as index 21. Drawing this card is not an Infection card draw. Draw onward to the next city card, add 1 Hollow Men figure there instead of infecting, and keep drawing through any further Gather cards. Only the first city revealed gets a figure.

rules: Second Hollow Men Gather card. Same printed rules and the same code, P2-21b, as index 21.
Drawing it is not an Infection card draw. Add 1 figure to the first city revealed, and do not infect that city.
notes: Separate scan from the other three Gather cards. The face still prints P2-21b, not P2-22b.
Goes to the Infection discard pile when the package is opened.
